scripts.check: if find extensions -name '*.ts' 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then tsc --noEmit; else echo 'No extension TypeScript files to check'; fi
scripts.test: if find extensions -name '*.test.ts' 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then node --test --experimental-strip-types extensions/*/*.test.ts; else echo 'No tests configured'; fi
